question: How should the dissolving form of Śiva be united with the image during withdrawal?
premises: Śiva is meditated upon as dissolving.
The act is performed by means of the image.
inference: Having meditated on Śiva as dissolving, one should unite him with the image by means of the image.
uncertainties: mūrtau mūrtyā may indicate a technical ritual identification
plain_english: Having meditated on Śiva as the dissolving one, one should unite him in the image by means of the image.
